item.title: Record snow drought in Western US raises concern for a spring of water shortages and wildfires
item.description: A record snow drought with unprecedented heat is hitting most of the American West, depleting future water supplies, making it more vulnerable to wildfires and hurting winter tourism and recreation.

item.title: Rockies and right-hander Tomoyuki Sugano agree to a $5.1 million, 1-year contract
item.description: The Colorado Rockies added Tomoyuki Sugano to their rotation on Tuesday, agreeing to a $5.1 million, one-year contract with the right-hander.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn's crash heightens fear for relatives of Olympic skiers
item.description: Families of skiers have always worried about the safety of their loved ones, but Lindsey Vonn’s horrifying crash has only heightened those fears.
